dogecoin.text:
By bridging $DOGE to Dogechain.

Holders of $DOGE migrate their coins from the Dogecoin native blockchain through the Dogechain bridge and in turn, get the wrapped version of DOGE — $WDOGE.

#Dogechain is a stand-alone EVM-compatible L2 blockchain that is supercharging Dogecoin with Web3 utilities.

It is also a community-first ecosystem for $DOGE and memecoins believers and holders, created by enthusiasts, who believe in memecoins.
